meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现、安装并接入页面组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 HyperFrames 搭建页面，想复用现成块或贡献新块。
copy.tagline_en: Discover, install, and wire page components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build pages with HyperFrames and want to reuse or contribute components.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会用 hyperframes add/catalog 安装、查找注册表里的块（独立子组合）和组件（效果片段），把装好的内容接进项目；目录里没有合适项时会引导你提交缺口反馈。
howto.when: 当你想用 hyperframes add 安装某块/组件、用 hyperframes catalog 搜索目录（查询须用英文），或要把项接进项目/改 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes add data-chart，装好就贴出接线片段。
say.note: 会安装块，并列出写入的文件和要贴的 HTML 片段。

say.text: 搜索结果都不合适时，跑 feedback --search-miss 报送缺口。
say.note: 会带上查询和想要的效果提交缺口报告。

howto.what_en: After enablement, Claude will use hyperframes add/catalog to install and search registry blocks (standalone sub-compositions) and components (effect snippets), wire installed items into the project, and submit a gap report when no catalog item fits.
howto.when_en: When you are running hyperframes add (one item or every block matching a tag) or hyperframes catalog (queries must be in English), or when wiring an item into index.html / editing hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes add data-chart and print the wiring snippet to paste.
say_en.note: Installs the block and lists files plus the snippet.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes catalog --query 'one line at a time' and list the matches.
say_en.note: Prints catalog matches ranked by relevance.

say_en.text: If nothing fits, run hyperframes feedback --search-miss to report the gap.
